test_title: PYST 63: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Easy does it

options.text: Used to tell someone to do something rarely
Used to tell someone to do something violently
Used to tell someone to do something slowly and carefully
Used to tell someone to do something horridly

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Easy does it"** means to do something slowly and carefully. (धीरे और सावधानी से कुछ करना) • **Example: **When lifting heavy objects, remember, easy does it to avoid injury. • **"Easy does it"** advises caution and a measured approach. (सावधानी और मापी हुई पद्धति की सलाह देना) • **Example: **While painting the delicate artwork, easy does it to ensure precision. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Used to tell someone to do something rarely** (किसी को कुछ कम बार करने के लिए कहना) • **Example:** You should eat junk food rarely to maintain good health. • **Option 2: Used to tell someone to do something violently** (किसी को कुछ हिंसक रूप से करने के लिए कहना) • **Example: **He was told to act violently in the action scene of the movie. • **Option 4: Used to tell someone to do something horridly** (किसी को कुछ भयानक तरीके से करने के लिए कहना) • **Example:** The villain in the story was asked to act horridly to frighten the audience. 39:Td1e, The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Do something in an inexpensive and easy way.
